		x = 50
		y = 1600
	}

	# Loaded one day after operation Poseidon and by the renewal of the war of
	# return on the corporate route. Every terminal path of the war runs
	# NAM_rtw_close, which restores the corporate tree. Shared history keeps the
	# completions of both trees across the swaps.
	# A wing bypasses itself once its enemy has left the war; the regime crisis,
	# the families' concession and both border capstones never bypass, so a
	# closed front leaves the bypassed side of its pair to the capstone's OR.

	# ----- Centre: the council at war -----

	shared_focus = NAM_rtw_war_cabinet

	# ----- North: the Eflor front -----

	# ----- South: the Azhar front -----

	# ----- Strait: hulls and fuel for the front -----

	# ----- Districts: the people of the homeland -----

}

				NAM_rtw_place_brigade = yes
				# Roads and the port of Svetlogorsk only once the district is the
